Anya R.: Hey team — requesting final approval to schedule the Meridian Health private rollout (dedicated slice) in eu-west. Target change window: Tue 2026-04-07 02:00-04:00 UTC.
Anya R.: Deployment plan: pin to r4.2.1-priv (sha: abcdef1234), staggered canary: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m/20m/20m waits. Rollback triggers: 4xx+5xx > 1.5x baseline OR 95th latency > 350ms for 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/meridian-private-rollout (see checklist).
DeployBot: Artifact built and verified: r4.2.1-priv (sha: abcdef1234). Automated smoke tests: PASS. Scheduling window requested: 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z. To schedule run: `/deploy schedule --env private --customer meridian --version r4.2.1-priv --window 02:00-04:00`
Kevin H.: quick Q — KMS rotation is on our calendar Tue 03:30 UTC in eu-west. That collides with the tail of the window. We need to either shift window earlier or coordinate with KeyOps.
Anya R.: good catch. Proposal: push canary start 02:15, full traffic by 03:10, so the active switch happens before rotation. If KeyOps can hold rotation by 30m that also works.
Sasha P.: Security: holding rotation is preferred if possible. If not, confirm that the private key IDs used for this customer are not being rotated (we have separate key). Please add the key id to the ticket.
Mike L.: Product: +1 for earlier start. Also please add a 2-sentence release note for the customer-facing ops doc: what changed and rollback safety. I can paste into the customer notification once it's ready.
Anya R.: release-note draft: "r4.2.1-priv: improved kv-cache efficiency and canary-aware routing fixes. No behavioral changes to API. Rollback safe within 20m if errors or latency regressions."
ops-runner: ops-runner here — I've added the runbook link, canary monitors (errors, p95 latency, error budget burn) and alert thresholds. I'll be oncall for the window. +1 pending KeyOps ack or KMS key id in ticket.
Lina C.: CS: Meridian prefers not to have customer-visible maintenance during 02:00-03:00 local time. Their timezone is CET; our window is 03:00-05:00 CET. They've asked if we can avoid heavy customer-impact actions after 03:00 CET.
Anya R.: noted. I adjusted plan: canary ramp completes by 03:10 UTC (04:10 CET) — hmm that still conflicts. Alternative: start 01:30 UTC to finish by 03:30 UTC? Thoughts?
Kevin H.: 01:30 start is doable but will be earlier for oncall. Ops-runner ok?
ops-runner: I can cover 01:30 start. That actually gives more buffer before KMS rotation. Recommend final window 01:30-03:30 UTC.
Sasha P.: Security ack as long as key id confirmed. Please put the key id (k-6789) in the ticket now.
DeployBot: Scheduled: meridian private rollout v=r4.2.1-priv window=2026-04-07T01:30:00Z..2026-04-07T03:30:00Z canary_steps=[10%,50%,100%] canary_timing=[15m,25m,20m] owner=@Anya R.
Anya R.: Final: setting window to Tue 2026-04-07 01:30-03:30 UTC. Pin: r4.2.1-priv. KMS key k-6789 included in ticket. ops-runner oncall. Security +1, Product +1, CS aware. @deploybot please kick at scheduled time. :thumbsup:
Kevin H.: +1 from SRE. I'll monitor KV cache and tail latency.
Mike L.: +1 from Product. I'll send the short customer note after this thread.
Sasha P.: +1 Security.
Lina C.: Customer notified and ok with the earlier window.
Anya R.: Thanks all — rolling on schedule. If anything changes ping this thread.
